description: Agent alerts: what matched a filter in the last 24 hours. Rounds announced in the startup press (and, with follow=all, Front Page stories) for a market and/or keyword (country, sector or company; accent-insensitive whole-word prefix, so "Colombia" matches "Colombian"). Call it on a schedule to watch a market; the same filters power IRIS email alerts (iris-media.xyz/alerts).
name: get_alert_matches
